Install this skill

Use the public repository's installer. You need Git and Python 3.10 or newer. The commands below install only {{name}} for the agent you choose.

1. Get the repository once

Run this in a terminal. If you already have this checkout, open it and update your clean local copy instead of cloning again.

{{clone}}

On Windows, use python or py -3 instead of python3 if that is how Python is installed.

2. Preview, then install

Run these commands from the context-templates folder. Read the preview first, then run the installation command.

{{installation}}

The installer preserves unrelated skills and refuses unmanaged conflicts or locally edited installed copies. It does not execute packaged scripts. Read the skill before using its tools.

3. Use it in your agent

Start a new agent session so it can discover the installed skill. Ask it to use {{name}} for your task and provide the relevant project context.
